package.description: Greenshot is a light-weight screenshot software tool for Windows.

en-US.description: Greenshot is a light-weight screenshot software tool for Windows.
en-US.longDescription: Greenshot is an open source screenshot tool for capturing a selected region, window, or desktop, and even complete (scrolling) web pages. With its integrated editor you can easily annotate, highlight, or obfuscate parts of the screenshot.
en-US.name: Greenshot Preview
